### `research/indicator_strategy/engine.py` (181 lines)
- PURPOSE: Indicator study engine: loads 1h spot OHLCV and resamples to 4h / 1d, computes the indicators (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ADX/DI, ATR, Donchian), builds named signals from triggers plus optional gates, and simulates trades with an ATR stop…
- TAGS: indicator screen, rsi, macd, bollinger breakout, adx trend, donchian, ema200 pullback, atr stop, r multiple, timeframe resample, trade simulator, gate, regime, cost in r
- PITFALLS: Indicators at bar t use closes up to t; signals at bar t fill at the OPEN of bar t+1. Stop is checked before target inside a bar (conservative); a gap through the stop fills at the open. One position per coin at a time. Wilder smoothing is implemented with ewm(alpha=1/n), an approximation of the textbook recursion.
- API:
  - `def load(path, tf)` L23
  - `def indicators(df)` L32
  - `def triggers(d)` L66
  - `def gates(d)` L81
  - `def build_signal(d, trigger, gate_names=())` L92
  - `def simulate(d, long, short, tf, atr_stop=ATR_STOP, atr_tgt=ATR_TGT, cost=COST)` L110
  - `def metrics(t)` L156
